summary: Reproduced the silent drop through Glm5NextForConditionalGeneration.load_weights, normalized transformers-written mHC/KDA/MoE names into the released layout, validated the actual destination loaders with representative tensors, and made malformed or unsupported required transformers-native weights fail explicitly. This verifies loader routing and tensor values/shapes, not end-to-end model quality.

tests.what_was_measured: Before the fix, the actual loader left the representative mHC destination at its sentinel value, demonstrating a silent drop. Raw output: /job/raw/before_actual_loader.txt

9 tests and 2 subtests passed. The regression invokes the production load_weights implementation and checks exact mHC, KDA forget-gate, packed conv1d, and packed MoE destination values/shapes; it also checks explicit errors for malformed and unsupported required weights. Raw output: /job/raw/pytest_glm5_adjacent.txt
Repository formatting, lint, spelling, and registered-test validation hooks passed. Raw output: /job/raw/precommit.txt

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-ea62e8fc6430/venv/bin/python - <<'PY' ... actual loader with CUDA tensors ... PY
tests.what_was_measured: On AMD Instinct MI350X, exact GPU comparisons against independently indexed source tensors passed for two experts' gate/up/down matrices and all q/k/v conv1d slices; destination shapes were also checked. Raw output: /job/raw/gpu_actual_loader.txt

gpu_evidence: PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 exposed exactly one assigned AMD Instinct MI350X. The actual loader consumed CUDA tensors and all exact numerical/shape assertions passed; see /job/raw/gpu_environment.txt and /job/raw/gpu_actual_loader.txt.
remaining_limitations: The full 628 GB GLM-5.3-Flash checkpoint was not present, so full server startup, generation, and benchmark quality were not tested.
Name routing plus representative exact tensor validation does not establish full-model quality.
No native C++ or FlyDSL code changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
